semantics.definition: How strong the soft light round an active astroid is at its middle, as a share of the astroid's colour (it fades to nothing at its edge): 0.5. A guess as a number, not your word: a session's pick. You saw the glow it makes in the intro and said "Glow is right" (23 Nov).
semantics.responsibility: Light the tiles round an active astroid.
